|notes=Set 8 was released 24 November 2004. [https://web.archive.org/web/20041204170841id_/http://www.swccgpc.com/interior.htm Release announcement]. The remaster replaces the original profession bonuses with forfeit protection for low-ability aliens, with a Molator exception. The lore-based activation becomes a qualifying battle destiny bonus. It adds an option to raise a converted site and drops Alter immunity.
